a: A Job runs pods until a specified number complete successfully.
CronJobs schedule Jobs on a time table.
StatefulSets manage pods with stable identities and storage.
DaemonSets run a pod on every node (or selected nodes).
RBAC controls who can perform actions on which resources.
Helm packages Kubernetes apps as charts.
kubectl apply declares desired state from manifests.
kubectl logs fetches container logs for debugging.
